name: Fast mode
summary: Get much quicker answers from the same model, at a higher price per token.
what: Fast mode runs supported models with an API setup tuned for speed, up to about 2.5 times faster. The answers are as good as usual; you pay more per token. It suits quick back-and-forth such as live debugging.

impact.title: Faster iteration
impact.detail: Shorter waits while you try, test and adjust.

impact.title: Same quality
impact.detail: Unlike lowering effort, the model itself doesn't change.

impact.title: Easy to toggle
impact.detail: Switch it on for a burst of work and off again.

howItWorks: Run /fast to turn it on or off; a ↯ icon shows when it's active.
Or set fastMode to true in your user settings.
Works on the Anthropic API with supported Opus and Fable models, not Sonnet or Haiku.
Not available on Amazon Bedrock or Microsoft Foundry.
On subscription plans it is billed from usage credits, outside plan limits.

events.note: Fast mode became available, starting with Opus 4.6.
